description: This source file provides a Python client for interacting with a Node-based Role Mapping Service. It includes functions to fetch competency maps, role adjacency, and role mapping details, utilizing HTTP requests with retries and error handling. The code defines custom exceptions, configuration helpers, and the main public API functions used for integrating with the external RoleMappingService.

classes.name: MappingServiceError
classes.description: Base exception class for errors related to the mapping service.

classes.name: MappingServiceUnavailable
classes.description: Exception raised when the mapping service is unreachable due to network issues or retries exhausted.

methods.name: str _get_base_url()
methods.description: Retrieve the base URL of the mapping service from configuration.

methods.name: float _get_timeout()
methods.description: Retrieve the HTTP request timeout setting from configuration.

methods.name: int _get_retries()
methods.description: Retrieve the number of retries for HTTP requests from configuration.

methods.name: bool _should_retry(status_code: int)
methods.description: Determine if an HTTP status code indicates a transient error warranting a retry.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any]|List[Any]|None _request_json( method: str, path: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None )
methods.description: Perform an HTTP request with retries and backoff, returning JSON response or raising custom exceptions.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,int]] get_competency_map_for_role(role_name: str)
methods.description: Fetch the competency map for a specific role by querying the external service.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_adjacent_roles(role_name: str, limit: int = 10, min_score: float = 0.0)
methods.description: Retrieve roles adjacent to a given role along with similarity scores.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_adjacency_details(current_role: str, target_role: str)
methods.description: Get detailed adjacency information connecting two roles from the service.
